statement: Pattern 描述可复用语义，Reference Demo 描述机制，而具体产品如何实现必须单独登记为 Platform Realization。Realization 绑定项目、平台、不可变 commit、源文件 blob、验证文件和限制；报告同时标记该 revision 是否仍等于项目当前 HEAD，避免把历史生产实现静默描述成当前实现。

scope.notes: Conservative Claim model of Experimental catalog record OPS.UIGS.PRODUCTION_REALIZATION_PROVENANCE; scope is limited to its recorded provenance and original statement.

review.rationale: Promotion review retained Experimental maturity. Three production implementations show adoption, but no independent runtime/final-output validation yet demonstrates that the provenance/currentness contract itself is enforced correctly.
